title: Listening Drill — Campus sculpture trail
description: Visitor briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Campus sculpture trail
sections.transcript:
GUIDE: Welcome to our visit to the campus sculpture trail. Before we leave, make sure your name appears on the list I'm holding. If you can't see your name, speak to me privately rather than adding it yourself.

GUIDE: Our meeting point is the clock tower. The visit itself will last forty minutes. You don't need to take anything heavy, but please bring a camera.

GUIDE: We'll finish at the art building. From there you can make your own way home. One last detail: please stay off the planted areas. If you're separated from the group, phone the number printed on your ticket rather than taking a shortcut.
